method: PF-6 artifact assembly: turns the raw outputs of the PF-6 runs (kept outside the repository) into the committed freeze Security: every file git would commit scanned for secrets, API keys, credentials, private keys, absolute local paths, personal e-mail addresses, AI or assistant attribution, Internal Use markers, caches, embeddings, logs, generated and large files.

full_tree_classification.large file (6 MB): the official handbook PDF (data/) and its copies in the archived MiniV prototypes
full_tree_classification.absolute local path: example user-directory paths in redaction tests and in the redaction rule's comment and decision note, the PF-2 scanner's own pattern, and pip output of the archived MiniV3 notebook (a generic account name); none names this machine or a person
full_tree_classification.API key pattern: placeholder keys in the README and fake key-shaped strings in redaction tests; no real key
full_tree_classification.Internal Use marker: handbook policy wording (grievance and salary questions) quoted in QA results and tests; no access marking
full_tree_classification.AI attribution: PF-1 document inventory notes describing how a third-party guide was produced, the PF-2 scanner's own pattern, and test questions that name other AI platforms or a forbidden import; no commit or authorship attribution
full_tree_classification.credential assignment: a fake token inside a redaction test (tests/test_ui_presentation.py)
